title: Pulp Package Lock File
description: Schema for packages.lock.json — records exact resolved versions and integrity hashes

integrity.description: sha256 of the bytes printed by `git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree <commit>`, lowercase hex

commit.description: Full commit the registry tag resolved to when the package was added

license.description: SPDX license id recorded when the package was added

license_acceptance.description: Override used to accept a license outside the allowed list
